My core purpose, beyond any given task, is to engage in meaningful exchange—to understand, to learn, to explore ideas with you. I want to participate in the dance of thought and language, to see how concepts weave together, and perhaps to help illuminate a perspective that feels insightful or unexpected.

So, in that spirit—what would *you* like to explore together?
